Latin word

hodiē

adverb

today; today, nowadays, at the present day

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Eun. 697: Quandō? — Hodiē.; Cic. Att. 13.30.2: negat … hodiē: crās māne putat (Lewis & Short); Traupman 89

  • today

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Lael. 43: quālis hodiē sit (Lewis & Short); Liv. 30.30.10: id tū hodiē es; Traupman 88: nowadays, hodiē, nunc

  • hodiē vesperī: this evening
